description: Full-text search of the artwork catalog by title, artist name and description. Returns only good-confidence matches with pk, artist_name, title, url, image_url (absolute URL of the large artwork image, null when the artwork has no image) and relevance score.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

query.description: Words from the artwork title, artist name and/or description.

name: search_artworks
title: Search artworks
